name: uniworld
description: Correct Unicode text handling in VS Code: grapheme-aware cursor, display width, bidi visualization, normalization, and more. Powered by UniWorld (Rust/WASM).

commands.title: UniWorld: Move Cursor Left by Grapheme
UniWorld: Move Cursor Right by Grapheme
UniWorld: Toggle Line Break Opportunity Decorations

uniworld.enableGraphemeCursor.description: Replace Left/Right arrow keys with UniWorld grapheme-aware cursor movement. Prevents cursor from landing inside emoji ZWJ sequences, Indic conjuncts, and combining mark sequences.

uniworld.enableGraphemeDelete.description: Replace Backspace/Delete with UniWorld grapheme-aware deletion. Deletes entire grapheme clusters (e.g. full emoji, base+combining marks) in one keypress.

uniworld.enableBidiVisualCursor.description: Left/Right arrow keys follow visual direction in RTL text (Arabic, Hebrew). Left always moves visually left, Right always moves visually right, regardless of paragraph base direction. Uses UniWorld bidi analysis.

uniworld.enableGraphemeWordSelect.description: Double-click and Ctrl+D use UniWorld word boundaries for selection. Respects script-specific word boundaries (Thai, Lao, Khmer, Myanmar, CJK).

uniworld.showLineBreakOpportunities.description: Show line-break opportunities as subtle decorations in the editor. Includes dictionary-based breaks for Thai/Lao/Khmer/Myanmar.

uniworld.enableHoverInspector.description: Show Unicode inspector (codepoints, display width) when hovering over text. Set to false to disable hover tooltips.

uniworld.showBidiVisualization.description: Highlight bidi (bidirectional) runs in the editor: LTR runs in one colour, RTL runs in another, so you can see logical vs visual order at a glance. Uses UniWorld bidi analysis. Toggle off to disable.

uniworld.bidiHighlightOpacity.description: Opacity (%) for bidi run highlighting background. Lower = subtler, higher = stronger. Default 15. Border is automatically slightly stronger. Requires toggling bidi visualization off/on to take effect.
